measure_pickle_size: measure the pickle serialized size of any Python object in bytes
assess_object_disk_size: assess how many bytes an object would take if written to a pickle file on disk
benchmark_compressed_image_size: benchmark the pickle size of a compressed image including associated metadata
compare_object_sizes: compare the pickle sizes of multiple objects to evaluate memory efficiency
profile_serialization_overhead: profile the serialization overhead of complex data structures using pickle size measurement
